files.README.md:
# Marketing Science Skills

Evidence-based marketing skills for Claude Code, powered by peer-reviewed marketing science.

## What is this?

A Claude Code plugin with **30 specialist marketing skills** that bring the rigor of Ehrenberg-Bass Institute research, Binet & Field effectiveness data, and behavioral science to your marketing workflow. Written in Belgian Dutch (nl-BE) with English marketing terminology where industry-standard.

## Quick Start

1. Install the plugin in Claude Code
2. Use `/marketing-context` to set up your client context
3. Invoke any skill by name (e.g., `/marketing-strategy`, `/brand-strategy`)
4. For complex multi-domain tasks, use `/marketing-orchestrator`

## Skills Overview

### Strategy & Planning
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/marketing-orchestrator` | Routes complex tasks to the right specialist skills |
| `/marketing-context` | Sets up client context (industry, B2B/B2C, KPIs, brand assets) |
| `/marketing-strategy` | B2B marketing strategy (Playing to Win, STP, Ehrenberg-Bass) |
| `/marketing-strategy-b2c` | B2C/FMCG strategy (penetration, mental/physical availability) |
| `/portfolio-strategy` | Multi-brand portfolio management and budget allocation |

### Brand & Product
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/brand-strategy` | Brand identity, DBAs, CEPs, tone of voice |
| `/product-marketing` | Positioning, pricing, launch playbooks |

### Content & Creative
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/content-marketing` | Content strategy, formats, SEO content, distribution |
| `/video-marketing` | Video strategy, scripting, production guidance |
| `/neuromarketing` | Behavioral science and cognitive biases in marketing |

### Channels & Execution
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/performance-marketing` | Paid media strategy, ROAS optimization |
| `/media-buying` | Tactical media buying (bidding, campaign structure) |
| `/digital-marketing` | Website strategy, martech, UX principles |
| `/social-media` | Social media strategy, community, influencer |
| `/seo-marketing` | Technical SEO, keyword strategy, link building |
| `/email-marketing` | Email lifecycle, segmentation, deliverability |
| `/marketing-automation` | Marketing automation workflows and lead scoring |

### Sales & Growth
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/sales-enablement` | B2B sales (Challenger Sale, MEDDPICC, ABM) |
| `/growth-marketing` | Growth loops, PLG, viral mechanics |
| `/conversion-optimization` | CRO, A/B testing, landing page optimization |
| `/conversion-b2c` | B2C e-commerce conversion and shopper marketing |

### Customer & Research
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/customer-experience` | Customer journey, retention, NPS, churn prevention |
| `/customer-research` | JTBD interviews, personas, VoC |
| `/marketing-research` | Research methodology and data analysis |
| `/competitor-analysis` | Competitive intelligence and battlecards |
| `/marketing-analytics` | Measurement frameworks, attribution, dashboards |

### Communications
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/pr-communications` | PR strategy, crisis comms, media relations |
| `/marketing-compliance` | GDPR, legal review, dark patterns detection |

### Quality Assurance
| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `/marketing-qa` | Comprehensive quality review (6-dimension scorecard) |
| `/marketing-red-team` | Challenge assumptions and find blind spots |

## 3-Layer QA Workflow

For important deliverables, use the 3-layer quality assurance workflow:

```
Generate output → /marketing-red-team → Address feedback → /marketing-qa → Final delivery
```

1. **Self-Check (automatic)**: Every skill runs an internal quality check before delivering output
2. **Red Team** (`/marketing-red-team`): Challenge assumptions, find blind spots
3. **Full QA** (`/marketing-qa`): Comprehensive review with scoring framework

## Scientific Foundation

| Framework | Author | Used In |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| How Brands Grow | Byron Sharp / Ehrenberg-Bass | All brand and strategy skills |
| The Long and the Short of It | Binet & Field | Budget allocation, campaign planning |
| Thinking Fast and Slow | Kahneman | CRO, creative, UX |
| Influence | Cialdini | Content, conversion, sales |
| Contagious (STEPPS) | Jonah Berger | Content, social, viral |
| Breakthrough Advertising | Eugene Schwartz | Content matching, awareness stages |
| Building a StoryBrand | Donald Miller | Messaging, copy |
| Tiny Habits (B=MAT) | BJ Fogg | CRO, behavior design |
| The Challenger Sale | Dixon & Adamson | B2B sales enablement |
| Growth Loops | Reforge / Balfour | Growth marketing |

## Architecture

```
marketing-science-skills/
├── .claude-plugin/marketplace.json    Plugin manifest
├── skills/                            30 specialist skills
│   └── skill-name/
│       ├── SKILL.md                   Core skill (max 500 lines)
│       └── references/                Detailed frameworks & templates
├── shared/                            Cross-skill resources
│   ├── marketing-science-glossary.md  Full glossary (664 lines)
│   ├── self-check-template.md         Quality check template
│   └── ehrenberg-bass-principles.md   Core EB principles
├── CLAUDE.md                          Plugin-level instructions
├── README.md
├── VERSIONS.md
└── LICENSE
```

## Origin

Migrated from an enterprise-grade Python-based marketing AI system (28 agents, 24,573 lines of prompts, 3-layer QA pipeline). The original system requires Python + API key + CLI knowledge. This plugin delivers the same scientific depth as zero-setup, markdown-only Claude Code skills.
